guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: * | The top- and bottom-line impacts of the newly acquired B. Braun products are reflected in this Business Outlook. LeMaitre anticipates recording ~$150,000 of Q4 2026 B. Braun product sales and break-even operating income impact.
** | 2025 results include a Q3 non-recurring benefit from the Employee Retention Tax Credit. Non-GAAP adjusted figures exclude this benefit. A reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP measures is included.
